"""Run-length encoding helpers.

run length, omitting the length when it is 1.

def encode(s):
    """Encode *s* using run-length encoding.

    Consecutive identical characters become the character followed by the
    run length; runs of length 1 omit the length.
    """
    result = []
    i = 0
    n = len(s)
    while i < n:
        ch = s[i]
        j = i + 1
        while j < n and s[j] == ch:
            j += 1
        run = j - i
        result.append(ch)
        if run > 1:
            result.append(str(run))
        i = j
    return "".join(result)


def decode(s):
    """Decode a run-length encoded string produced by :func:`encode`."""
    result = []
    i = 0
    n = len(s)
    while i < n:
        ch = s[i]
        if not ch.isalpha():
            raise ValueError("invalid encoded character: %r" % ch)
        i += 1
        j = i
        while j < n and s[j].isdigit():
            j += 1
        if j == i:
            run = 1
        else:
            run = int(s[i:j])
            i = j
        result.append(ch * run)
    return "".join(result)


if __name__ == "__main__":

    assert decode("a3bc2") == "aaabcc"
    assert decode(encode("aaaaaaaaaaaa")) == "aaaaaaaaaaaa"
